rv.q: If you’re a fan of music, you’re a fan of this show.
In case I haven’t made it clear: the music alone makes “Blue Heaven” worth seeing.
Brooks's Blue Heaven is one of the best production written for the Black Ensemble Theater and is delightfully entertaining from beginning to end.
Even if you are not a typical blues fan, this show is just plain good music and phenomenal performance.
Brooks’s ensemble shines in this heavenly dive into the blues.

cn.t: Black Ensemble Theater's jukebox musical earns praise for its joyful celebration of blues legends and powerhouse performances, though it follows the company's familiar formula. Critics highlight the soulful energy and talented cast in this heavenly 90-minute tribute.
